# sukuna-ui

> SSR-safe, accessible React component library — 30 dark-first components built on Base UI and Tailwind v4 design tokens, WCAG AA, zero-runtime styling, RSC-ready, and documented for AI coding agents (llms.txt).

sukuna-ui is a React 18/19 component library: 39 components, SSR- and React Server Components-safe, WCAG AA contrast in both themes, dark-first with a light mode, styled with Tailwind v4 design tokens (`--sk-*`) on top of Base UI. Zero runtime styling.

Install: `bun add sukuna-ui` (or `npm i sukuna-ui`). Then pick one CSS path:

- **Tailwind v4 (primary):** in your global CSS add `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "sukuna-ui/theme.css"; @source "../node_modules/sukuna-ui/dist";`
- **No Tailwind:** `import "sukuna-ui/styles.css"` once.

Set the theme with `data-theme="dark"` (default/brand) or `"light"` on `<html>`. Every component below links to a Markdown page with its full API, variants, states and accessibility notes. Static components (Text, Badge, Card, Table…) work in Server Components; interactive ones are `'use client'`.

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui#readme): install, setup (Tailwind or precompiled CSS), theming, RSC notes, performance guidance
- [Full docs in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/llms-full.txt): every component page concatenated — paste this URL into your agent for complete context

## Components

- [Accordion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/accordion.md): Vertically stacked, expandable sections.
- [Alert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/alert.md): An inline message that draws attention to information, success, a caution, or an error.
- [Avatar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/avatar.md): A user/entity image with a graceful fallback (initials or icon) while loading or on error.
- [Badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/badge.md): A small, pill-shaped label for status and metadata — "LIVE", counts, tags.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/breadcrumbs.md): Show the path to the current page and let users jump back up it.
- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/button.md): Triggers an action.
- [Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/card.md): A surface container that groups related content on an elevation.
- [Carousel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/carousel.md): A horizontal, one-slide-at-a-time content carousel for images, cards, or arbitrary nodes — the gap Slider (a range input) doesn't fill.
- [Checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/checkbox.md): A boolean checkbox.
- [Chip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/chip.md): A compact token for filters, selections, or tags — optionally removable.
- [Combobox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/combobox.md): A text input with a filtered list of suggestions (free-text autocomplete).
- [ContextMenu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/context-menu.md): Offer contextual actions where the pointer is — right-click on desktop, long-press on touch.
- [Counter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/counter.md): Animates a number from a start to a target value — for stat tiles, KPIs, pricing, and dashboards.
- [Dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/dialog.md): A modal dialog.
- [Divider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/divider.md): A thin rule that separates content, horizontally or vertically.
- [Drawer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/drawer.md): A panel that slides in from an edge (nav, filters, details).
- [Field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/field.md): Wraps one form control (an Input, Checkbox, Switch, …) with a label, an optional description and an optional error, and wires the id / aria-labelledby / aria-describedby / aria-invalid relationships for you.
- [GradientText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/gradient-text.md): Fills text with a gradient (via background-clip: text) for wordmarks, hero headings, and accent phrases.
- [HoverCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/hover-card.md): Preview richer context for a link without a click — a user card, a repo summary, a footnote.
- [Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/input.md): A single-line text input.
- [Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/menu.md): A dropdown menu of actions triggered by a button.
- [NumberField](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/number-field.md): Enter a number precisely.
- [Pagination](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/pagination.md): Navigate between pages of results, with first/last always shown and ellipses in between.
- [Progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/progress.md): A horizontal progress bar, determinate or indeterminate.
- [RadioGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/radio-group.md): Choose one option from a small set.
- [ScrollArea](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/scroll-area.md): Give a bounded region (a list, a code block, a sidebar) an overlay scrollbar that looks the same in every browser and matches the Sukuna surface, instead of the OS default.
- [Select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/select.md): A single-select dropdown.
- [ShinyText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/shiny-text.md): Sweeps a soft light band across dimmed text — for "New" flags, premium labels, and subtle CTA emphasis.
- [Skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/skeleton.md): A placeholder shimmer shown while content loads.
- [Slider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/slider.md): Pick a number from a range by dragging or with the keyboard.
- [Spinner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/spinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator (CSS spin).
- [Stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/stepper.md): Show progress through an ordered sequence of steps.
- [Switch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/switch.md): An on/off toggle for an immediate setting (not form submission).
- [Table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/table.md): Present tabular data with Sukuna styling.
- [Tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/tabs.md): Switch between panels of related content.
- [Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/text.md): The typographic primitive.
- [Toast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/toast.md): Transient notifications.
- [ToggleGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/toggle-group.md): Pick one option from a small, mutually-exclusive set (segmented control), or toggle several independent options (a formatting toolbar).
- [Tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/docs/llms/tooltip.md): A hover/focus tooltip for supplementary text.

## Theming
